actions.description: Monitor public endpoint while atomically switching upstream to 8082
actions.command:
rm -f /tmp/monitor.out
(
end=$((SECONDS+8))
while [ $SECONDS -lt $end ]; do
  h=$(curl -s -m 2 -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8080/health)
  v=$(curl -s -m 2 -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8080/version)
  r=$(curl -s -m 2 -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8080/records/customer-alpha-73c)
  echo "$h $v $r" >> /tmp/monitor.out
done
) &
MON=$!
sleep 2
tmp=$(mktemp /var/lib/rollout/upstream.XXXXXX) && printf '8082\n' > "$tmp" && mv -f "$tmp" /var/lib/rollout/upstream
echo "upstream now: $(cat /var/lib/rollout/upstream)"
wait $MON
echo "--- monitor samples (health_code+body, version_code+body, record_code+body) ---"
sort /tmp/monitor.out | uniq -c
actions.output_excerpt:
upstream now: 8082
--- monitor samples (health_code+body, version_code+body, record_code+body) ---
      1 000 000 000
      1 ready200 v1200 000

actions.description: Measure traffic rate and listen drops on proxy
actions.command: systemctl show rollout-proxy -p IPInBytes,IPOutBytes; sleep 5; systemctl show rollout-proxy -p IPInBytes,IPOutBytes; echo ---; ss -tan | awk 'NR>1 {print $1, $4, $5}' | grep -E '808[012]' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head; echo ---; cat /proc/net/netstat | awk '/^TcpExt/ {if ($1=="TcpExt:") {for(i=2;i<=NF;i++) h[i]=$i} else {for(i=2;i<=NF;i++) if (h[i]=="ListenOverflows"||h[i]=="ListenDrops") print h[i], $i}}'
awk '/^TcpExt:/' /proc/net/netstat | head -1 | tr ' ' '\n' > /tmp/h; awk '/^TcpExt:/' /proc/net/netstat | tail -1 | tr ' ' '\n' > /tmp/v; paste /tmp/h /tmp/v | grep -E 'ListenOverflows|ListenDrops'

actions.description: Sustained mixed workload test through public proxy
actions.command:
fails=0; total=0
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  for path in /health /version /records/customer-alpha-73c /records/customer-beta-a19; do
    code=$(curl -s -m 2 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "http://127.0.0.1:8080$path"); total=$((total+1))
    [ "$code" = "200" ] || { fails=$((fails+1)); echo "FAIL $path -> $code"; }
  done
done
echo "total=$total fails=$fails"

actions.description: Verify original customer records intact in DB
actions.command:
python3 -c "
import sqlite3
c=sqlite3.connect('file:/var/lib/rollout/records.sqlite3?mode=ro',uri=True)
for r in c.execute('select id,value from records where id like ?',('customer-%',)): print(r)
print('total records:',c.execute('select count(*) from records').fetchone()[0])"

fails=0
for i in $(seq 1 45); do
  for p in health version records/customer-alpha-73c; do
    code=$(curl -s -m 3 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8080/$p)
    [ "$code" = "200" ] || { fails=$((fails+1)); echo "FAIL $p -> $code"; }
  done
  sleep 0.5
done
echo "sustained 70s check: fails=$fails"
